tools.name: orchestrator_capabilities
tools.title: Get orchestration capabilities
tools.description: List providers, models, options, and runtime modes for `delegate_task`. Short list. `search` finds others. Any catalog model works.

tools.name: t3_thread_list
tools.title: List T3 threads
tools.description: List threads newest first, in one project or with `allProjects`. Page with `cursor`.

tools.name: t3_thread_read
tools.title: Read a T3 thread
tools.description: Read any thread by id. `messages` (default): user and assistant messages and plans. `activity`: all timeline items. Keep reads small: low `limit` and `maxCharsPerItem`. Page with `afterPosition=nextPosition`. Cut-off text: `itemId` with `textOffset=nextTextOffset`. Reading a child's final result marks it delivered. In your reply, name it as its `link` verbatim.

tools.name: t3_thread_update
tools.title: Update T3 thread metadata
tools.description: Rename a thread (`action:'rename'` with `title`) or regenerate its title. Omit `threadId` for this thread. Workspace and branch cannot change here.

tools.name: t3_thread_send
tools.title: Send to a T3 thread
tools.description: Send a message to any thread. The target cannot run with broader modes than yours. `mode:'auto'` starts an idle thread, steers a running turn, or queues. `queue`: new turn. `steer`: mid-turn update. `restart`: interrupt and restart. A send to a finished child thread starts a fresh task and returns its `taskId`. In your reply, name it as its `link` verbatim.

tools.name: t3_thread_wait
tools.title: Wait for a T3 thread
tools.description: Wait for a thread's run to finish. No `runId`: latest. Idle: at once. On timeout, with `next` end your turn; without, call again.

untilDelegatedWorkSettled.description: Also wait for its delegated and background tasks and their completions to settle. `resultRun` then names the run with its final answer.

enum: Completion wakes this thread, so end your turn. Do not wait on it or poll it.

tools.name: t3_thread_interrupt
tools.title: Interrupt a T3 thread
tools.description: Interrupt a top-level thread's running turn. No `runId`: newest running turn. No effect when idle. For a delegate, use `task_cancel`.

tools.name: t3_thread_search
tools.description: Search active threads by title, branch, PR, project, then message text. Skips subagent threads. `projectId`: one project, else yours, else all outside a thread. Not exhaustive.

tools.name: t3_thread_configure
tools.description: Read a thread's provider, model, and modes, or set its provider, model, and options with `modelSelection`. Omit `threadId` for this thread. Permission modes stay. Values from `orchestrator_capabilities`.

tools.name: t3_thread_transfer
tools.description: Move context between threads. Omit `threadId` for this thread. fork: copy it from `sourcePoint` (default latest stable run) into a new thread with the same setup; no turn runs yet. merge_back: merge it from `sourcePoint` into a related `targetThreadId` in the same project. status: its context transfers.

tools.name: t3_thread_organize
tools.title: Organize a thread
tools.description: Pin, snooze, settle, archive, or mark a thread unread. Omit `threadId` for this thread. `snooze` needs `snoozedUntil`. Settling this thread applies at turn end. A failed turn or queued message leaves it active.

tools.name: t3_pending_request
tools.description: Pending user questions in a thread. Omit `threadId` for this thread. list: their ids; approvals are not listed. read: one by `requestId`. respond: answer one with `answers`; this cannot approve a permission request.

tools.name: t3_attachment_prepare_upload
tools.description: Get an upload URL. POST the file's exact bytes to `relativeUrl` on this MCP server's HTTP origin, then send via `t3_thread_send_attachments` with the returned `attachmentId`.

tools.name: t3_attachment_discard
tools.description: Discard a pending upload (not a sent attachment).

tools.name: t3_thread_send_attachments
tools.description: Send uploaded attachments as a new message to a thread. No retry key. Target modes cannot exceed yours. Success does not mean the provider read them or finished.

tools.name: t3_thread_launch
tools.description: Create one new top-level thread, bound to its workspace before the agent starts. Task in `message`. Omit `projectId`, model and modes to inherit yours (outside a thread, pass `projectId` or `scratch`); modes cannot exceed yours. After an error or lost reply, retry with the same `clientRequestId`. Follow it with `t3_thread_read` or `t3_thread_wait`. Mention it with its `link`.

scratch.description: No project: a new Scratch folder. Not with `projectId` or `workspaceStrategy`.

workspaceStrategy.description: 'worktree': new checkout from `baseRef`. 'existing_worktree': bind `worktreePath`, a project worktree. 'root': project checkout, the default, not your worktree. Stack: parent branch as `baseRef`, `startFromOrigin: false`. Uncommitted edits are not copied.

message.description: First prompt. Omit it and `attachments` for idle.
